Keep branching at any depth.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin
for isolated follow-ups that can keep branching recursively, with no
plugi"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"n-defined depth limit. Start a side trail from any answer, then turn any

that existed at the"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" selected answer.
- **Keep branching at any depth.** Every answer in every side trail can become
ano"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ther isolated fork point. Apply the same action again at every new level.

| Open a new conversation | Lost or copied"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" manually | Yes | No | No |
| Typical temporary sidebar Q&A; | Varies | Usually | Usually a linear s"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ide thread | Usually not |
| **dsh-nested-followups** | **Exact ancestor path** | **Yes** | **Yes—re"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"cursively, with no fixed depth** | **Yes** |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The distinguishing feature is not the canvas. It is that any answer at any
depth can become another "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"isolated fork point, and the same rule keeps applying

remains available on"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" every answer at every later depth._"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Why every level is a real branch"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"This is not a prompt that asks the model to pretend later messages do not
exist, and it is not a lin"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"e drawn between unrelated chats."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- Every branch, including a branch created inside another branch, is a real
DeepSeek Harness session"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" with durable history.
- The same fork rule applies recursively at every level; the plugin does not
"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"impose a nesting-depth limit.

- Later messages from the"},{"id":"p21s5","text":" main task, parent side trail, and sibling branches are

- Messages never flow upward to a parent session or sideways to a sibling.
- Branch to"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"ols are enforced read-only when they execute, protecting the shared
workspace from side-question act"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"ivity.
- The request prefix remains byte-for-byte compatible with the parent at the
fork point, so t"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"he model provider can reuse its prefix cache."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## What Tree View includes"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- One card per user message and assistant answer, with the main conversation

- Unlimited nested follow-ups and linear continuation within e"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ach branch.
- Search that reveals collapsed ancestors before centering a match.
- Focus mode, pan, z"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"oom, fit-to-view, and a minimap for large trees.
- Progressive dot → capsule → card expansion, plus "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"one-action collapse.
- Cascading branch deletion with an exact branch and message count.
- Durable b"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ranch metadata and per-conversation view state across restarts.
- No branch entries in the normal si"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"per-conversation view state across restarts.
- No branch entries in the normal sidebar session list."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Requirement | Version |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-rc.5`, plus the verified alpha and legacy host versions above |
| Node.j"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"s (source build / Web) | `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` |
| Package manager (source build) | pnpm |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Compatibility notes"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The source branch bridges both legacy rc and current 0.2 contracts: Session
snapshots, inherited his"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"tory, read-only persistence handles, process-local
assistant streaming, tool results, native icons, "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"and message rendering. It
does not patch DSH or rewrite its logs. Forks still stop at completed turn"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"s;
the newer host's ability to fork an open turn is deliberately not used."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Automated validation and the exact runtime checks are recorded separately.
Desktop shares the Web pl"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ugin mechanism; a Web boot is not a packaged Desktop
end-to-end test.
See DSH version compatibility "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"for the
contract mapping and maintainer verification procedure."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The current development target is DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`; the same source is also

These adapters are included in npm `0.2.3`. DSH `"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"0.2.2-alpha.2` requires
Node.js 24.9 or later; packaged Desktop supplies its own runtime."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"**Branches cannot be continued from the standard chat view.** DSH currently

"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"continuation, but enables it only when DSH explicitly guarantees message
